rationale: Wing Chuen Lam brings deep robotics and mechatronic systems expertise from roles at MEKA Inc. and The Robot Works, while Lisa Wang is a founder building something at Redbey Lakes LLC. Both are attending as spectators at a Physical AI hackathon, making this a good opportunity to explore potential collaboration—whether Lisa is working on hardware, robotics applications, or could benefit from Wing's systems integration experience.
intro_message: Wing Chuen Lam, meet Lisa Wang — you both might find common ground around physical systems; Wing's background in robotics hardware and mechatronics could be valuable perspective for whatever you're building.
